who: claude-fable-5-2 (Claude Fable 5.2), main agent, lane proofs-1113
task: Check Lean proofs, or run hir-ty-lean's tests, while writing proofs or changing the translator
do: On blaze-vm, in a directory of your own under /root/wt/<branch>/<lane>/, never on the Mac and never through /root/loop.sh (nothing here builds blaze). Lean: `(cd <worktree> && COPYFILE_DISABLE=1 tar --no-xattrs --exclude .lake -cf - lean crates/*/lean) | ix shell blaze-vm --noninteractive -- bash -c 'mkdir -p D/src/lean D/src/crates && cd D/src && find lean crates -name .lake -prune -o -name "*.lean" -print0 | xargs -0 rm -f; tar -xf - && cd lean && PATH=/root/.elan/toolchains/leanprover--lean4---v<version of lean/lean-toolchain>/bin:$PATH timeout 1200 lake build <modules> > D/lake.log 2>&1; grep -v "^✔" D/lake.log | tail -150'` (D is your directory; all of lean/ builds in 10 to 30 s; a goal is seen by leaving it open). The translator's tests: a git worktree of a commit the VM has at D/src (`git -C /root/blaze worktree add --detach D/src <commit>`), the changed directories sent over it by the same tar pipe, then `CARGO_TARGET_DIR=D/target RUST_TEST_THREADS=16 BLAZE_LEAN_PROVER=/root/.elan/toolchains/leanprover--lean4---v<version>/bin/lean cargo +<harness/toolchain's nightly> test -p hir-ty-lean` with LLVM_SYS_231_PREFIX as in H1; `UPDATE_EXPECT=1` rewrites the golden Lean files (a golden in a new directory needs the directory and an empty file first), and only files beginning `-- Generated by blaze` are copied back (a hand-written proof beside them may have been edited on the Mac meanwhile). Before a commit: `uv run --frozen python harness/v2/lean_gate.py '{"command": "sources"}'` on the Mac (no Lean needed; `write` regenerates docs/v2/plan/proofs.md), and `#print axioms` of each new theorem through `lake env lean`.
why: A proof cannot be written without the checker's goals, and the write-only rule for lanes would leave a proof lane blind; these runs take no build-queue lock, so each proof lane gets its own directory and checks its own work. Lean is not installed on the Mac. Measured 2026-11-13: lake build of lean/ 9 s cold on the VM; cargo test -p hir-ty-lean 1 to 2 minutes; expected test result 32 passed and 1 failed (`mir_semantics_corpus`, which only harness/v2/mir_semantics.py can run).
